analysis:
Examined head lines 1-484 of docs/reference/configuration.md. Within these units, the only changed line is line 3, the date bump from 2026-10-30 to 2026-10-31. The remaining text in these units is unchanged context. It covers GLM local qualification, prefix cache default-on and DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0 (T-041), add-on hold (TB-012), sandbox (TB-013), endpoint resumption and logout (A-008, TB-011, T-053), and App Attest worker flags. No security regression is visible in these units.

The substantive change sits in head lines 923-1015 (Cluster runtime facts), per the file_changes patch excerpt. It is not in these units. The new text says signed releases register cluster_runtime in the POST /v1/releases payload. A coordinator that accepts it derives cluster approvals, pair-serving grants and parity qualifications from it. This shifts approval authority from a manually edited operator approval file to release registration. That ties it to A-005 (release API key) and to A-011 and A-017 (binary-hash registry and build qualifications).

The change could conflict with T-054 and A-017, under which release publication alone is not qualification. Integration should check the following:
- whether that section documents any independent operator approval gate before release-derived approvals become authoritative;
- whether it implies that release publication grants pair-serving, contrary to T-052, T-054 and A-017;
- whether the threat model needs updating for cluster approval provenance.

The backend implementation is platform-owned and outside the supplied evidence.
